routeScreen.funding: USDC on the vault's own chain
routeScreen.legs: USDC -> position -> USDC (round trip, worst notional reported)
routeScreen.tracked: EVM chains only. Solana is not tracked: routeTracked is false and every other route field is null.

verdicts.OK: round trip retained at least 97% at the worst probed size
verdicts.DEGRADED: retained 85% to 97%: enterable, with a loss
verdicts.DANGEROUS: retained under 85%: a deposit can look successful and still be a loss
verdicts.UNPRICEABLE: the output could not be priced, which is treated as a failure
verdicts.NO_ROUTE: no round trip could be completed (see routeReasonClass)
verdicts.SKIPPED: our own probe was rate-limited: unjudged, not a statement about the vault

routeScreen.nullMeaning: routeVerdict null means no verdict: not tracked (routeTracked false) or not screened yet. It is never a pass.
routeScreen.routeFresh: false means routeCheckedAt is older than freshWithinHours; the verdict may not reflect today.
routeScreen.disclaimer: Research and information, not investment advice.
